requirements.title: trials run executes a local-model SWE task suite via agent-manager + workspace-sandbox and records success/tokens/time history
requirements.description: `trials run` dispatches SWE tasks (add-feature/research/comprehend/bugfix + negative cases) through agent-manager (runner=opencode + local-model config) inside workspace-sandbox, evaluates by deterministic checks where possible and an agent-judge otherwise, and appends success-rate + tokens + wall-time to a historical time-series.

validation.notes: API: history store appends and trends; evaluator dispatch seam-tested with a fake runner; target api/internal/trials.
E2E: sandboxed dispatch with a stub agent-manager run; target bas/cases/trials.
Live local-model e2e trial (expensive; on demand); runbook in docs/internal/TESTING.md.

requirements.title: tracks % of Guide tasks with a live empirical gate
requirements.description: Each Guide-space task category maps to zero or more empirical gates; the trials domain computes and reports gate coverage over the Guide space as a recursive readiness metric.

validation.notes: API: gate-coverage computation over the Guide space; target api/internal/trials.
CLI: trials coverage output; target cli/domains/trials.
